classes.name: association
classes.label: association
classes.definition: not-for-profit organization that is owned by and acts on behalf of its members

classes.name: cooperative society
classes.label: cooperative society
classes.definition: organization owned by and operated for the benefit of those using its services

classes.name: family office
classes.label: family office
classes.definition: organization that assumes the day-to-day administration and management of a family's affairs

classes.name: functional business entity
classes.label: functional business entity
classes.definition: functional entity defined in terms of the nature of the commercial activity it conducts

classes.name: functional entity
classes.label: functional entity
classes.definition: party defined in terms of a function they or it performs

classes.name: merchant
classes.label: merchant
classes.definition: party engaged in the purchase and sales of goods produced by others for profit

classes.name: merchant category code
classes.label: merchant category code
classes.definition: code used internationally to classify a merchant

classes.name: merchant category code scheme
classes.label: merchant category code scheme
classes.definition: scheme defining a set of codes for classifying merchant services

classes.name: merchant identifier
classes.label: merchant identifier
classes.definition: unique identifier for a merchant that is used, for example, for transaction interchange purposes

classes.name: syndicate
classes.label: syndicate
classes.definition: temporary, self-organizing group of people, companies, corporations or entities organized as an alliance whose purpose is to transact some specific business, or to pursue or promote a shared interest

classes.name: syndicate member
classes.label: syndicate member
classes.definition: role of an individual or organization that is a member of an alliance set up to pool resources and share risk with respect to a large transaction

classes.name: API-first market data provider

classes.name: alternative data provider
classes.label: alternative data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies non-traditional datasets derived from sources such as web activity, sentiment analysis, geospatial signals, or other alternative information channels

classes.name: crypto and digital-asset data provider
classes.label: crypto and digital-asset data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies pricing, reference data, and analytics for digital tokens and crypto-assets

classes.name: derivatives and volatility data provider
classes.label: derivatives and volatility data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies pricing, implied-volatility surfaces, and analytics for derivatives, including options, futures, and structured products

classes.name: exchange-sourced data provider
classes.label: exchange-sourced data provider

classes.name: fixed income specialist provider
classes.label: fixed income specialist provider
classes.definition: market data provider that focuses on pricing, reference data, and analytics for fixed-income instruments such as bonds, credit products, and money-market securities

classes.name: institutional market data provider
classes.label: institutional market data provider
classes.definition: market data provider that supplies multi-asset financial information, analytics, and reference data to financial institutions such as banks, asset managers, and trading firms

classes.name: market data provider
classes.label: market data provider
classes.definition: publisher that supplies financial information, reference data, analytics, or related datasets used in financial markets

classes.name: publication
classes.label: publication
classes.definition: document offered for general distribution and usually produced in multiple copies

classes.name: publisher
classes.label: publisher
classes.definition: role of person(s) or organization(s) responsible for the printing or distribution of an item, whether in digital or print (physical) form

classes.name: reference data specialist provider
classes.label: reference data specialist provider
classes.definition: market data provider that focuses on authoritative reference data, including corporate actions, instrument identifiers, classifications, and entity information aligned with ISO standards

classes.name: branch of government
classes.label: branch of government
classes.definition: division of the government of a state, with separate and independent powers and areas of responsibility so that the powers of one branch are not in conflict with the powers associated with the other branches

classes.name: devolved government
classes.label: devolved government
classes.definition: government and the politicians that that run a subnational territory with powers that may be temporary and reversible, ultimately residing with the central government

classes.name: executive branch
classes.label: executive branch
classes.definition: the branch of government that is authorized and responsible for the daily administration of the government

classes.name: federal government
classes.label: federal government
classes.definition: union of states under a central government distinct from the individual governments of the separate states

classes.name: federated sovereignty
classes.label: federated sovereignty
classes.definition: polity characterized by a union of partially self-governing states or regions under a central (federal) government

classes.name: government
classes.label: government
classes.definition: system by which a state or community is controlled

classes.name: government agency
classes.label: government agency
classes.definition: permanent or semi-permanent organization, often an appointed commission, in the machinery of government that is responsible for the oversight and administration of specific functions

classes.name: government appointee
classes.label: government appointee
classes.definition: individual designated by government decree to lead, or participate in some capacity in a government body

classes.name: government body
classes.label: government body
classes.definition: formal organization that is an agency, instrumentality, or other body of a supranational, national, federal, state, or local government, including certain multijurisdictional agencies and departments that carry out the business of government

classes.name: government department
classes.label: government department
classes.definition: specialized organization responsible for a sector of government public administration

classes.name: government minister
classes.label: government minister
classes.definition: government official that is an executive, who is either appointed or elected to a high office in the government

classes.name: government official
classes.label: government official
classes.definition: person elected or appointed to administer some aspect of a government

classes.name: instrumentality
classes.label: instrumentality
classes.definition: organization that serves a public purpose and is closely tied to a government, but is not a government agency

classes.name: judiciary
classes.label: judiciary
classes.definition: branch of government that comprises the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in the name of the supranational, national, federal, or regional government, depending on its jurisdiction

classes.name: legislature
classes.label: legislature
classes.definition: the law-making body of a political unit, usually a national government, that has power to enact, amend, and repeal public policy

classes.name: municipal entity
classes.label: municipal entity
classes.definition: polity that typically represents a city, township, or other administrative subdivision having corporate status and powers of self-government or jurisdiction

classes.name: municipal government
classes.label: municipal government
classes.definition: regional government of a city, township, or other administrative subdivision

classes.name: national government
classes.label: national government
classes.definition: government and the politicians that that run a country as a whole (as opposed to local government)

classes.name: polity
classes.label: polity
classes.definition: legal person that is a supranational entity, crown, state, or subordinate civil authority, such as a province, prefecture, county, municipality, city, or district representing the people of that entity

classes.name: regional government
classes.label: regional government
classes.definition: administrative body for a geographic area, such as a county, smaller town, or other similar community

classes.name: regional sovereignty
classes.label: regional sovereignty
classes.definition: legal person that corresponds to an administrative division, administrative unit, administrative entity or country subdivision (or, sometimes, geopolitical division or subnational entity), that has the capacity to incur debt, issue contracts, and enter into relations with other similar entities

classes.name: sovereign state
classes.label: sovereign state
classes.definition: non-physical juridical entity that is represented by one centralized government that has sovereignty over a geographic area

classes.name: supranational entity
classes.label: supranational entity
classes.definition: governmental or non-governmental entity that is established by international law or treaty or incorporated at an international level

classes.name: tribal area
classes.label: tribal area
classes.definition: designation for geographic region administered by a group of indigenous people rather than by a sovereign state or regional governmental entity

classes.name: tribal entity
classes.label: tribal entity
classes.definition: legal entity that represents fundamental unit of sovereign tribal (indigenous) government

classes.name: tribal government
classes.label: tribal government
classes.definition: government representing a group of indigenous people that has legal authority to govern those people, including authority to legislate the existence of tribal entities

classes.name: benefit corporation
classes.label: benefit corporation
classes.definition: not-for-profit corporation set up under specific state legislation, typically to provide some social benefit, without an obligation to maximize shareholder return

classes.name: board agreement
classes.label: board agreement
classes.definition: formal, legally binding agreement between members of the Board of Directors of the organization

classes.name: common interest development corporation
classes.label: common interest development corporation
classes.definition: not-for-profit corporation set up under specific state legislation as a business entity for homeowners' associations

classes.name: corporation
classes.label: corporation
classes.definition: formal organization that is a legal entity (artificial person) distinct from its owners, created under the jurisdiction of the laws of a state or nation

classes.name: for profit corporation
classes.label: for profit corporation
classes.definition: corporation whose objective is to make money, i.e., to ensure realization of a financial benefit such that the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

classes.name: incorporation guarantee
classes.label: incorporation guarantee
classes.definition: guarantee that is part of the financial basis by which some legal entity is incorporated

classes.name: instrument of incorporation
classes.label: instrument of incorporation
classes.definition: memorandum and articles of association by which some legal entity is established

classes.name: joint stock company
classes.label: joint stock company
classes.definition: for-profit, unincorporated business that has some characteristics of a corporation and some features of a partnership, with ownership interests represented by shares of stock

classes.name: not-for-profit corporation
classes.label: not-for-profit corporation
classes.definition: corporation approved by its jurisdictional oversight and tax authorities as operating for educational, charitable, social, religious, civic or humanitarian purposes

classes.name: privately held company
classes.label: privately held company
classes.definition: corporation whose issued shares are all held by a family or a small group of investors and, therefore, cannot be bought by the public

classes.name: publicly held company
classes.label: publicly held company
classes.definition: corporation whose shares are traded and held publicly

classes.name: registration identifier
classes.label: registration identifier
classes.definition: identifier that is officially allocated to an organization at the time of registration, typically in a jurisdiction in which said organization is organized or registered and used in that jurisdiction to identify the organization

classes.name: registration identifier scheme
classes.label: registration identifier scheme
classes.definition: scheme that defines the registration identifier per the issuing registration authority

classes.name: religious corporation
classes.label: religious corporation
classes.definition: not-for-profit corporation whose objective is specific to some fundamental set of beliefs and practices generally agreed upon by a number of people, and that is incorporated under the law

classes.name: stock corporation
classes.label: stock corporation
classes.definition: corporation that has shareholders, each of whom receives a portion of the ownership of the corporation through shares of stock

classes.name: branch
classes.label: branch
classes.definition: part of a larger organization that might not be co-located with it

classes.name: division
classes.label: division
classes.definition: part of an organization, such as a line of business, that may have separate accounting and reporting requirements

classes.name: joint venture
classes.label: joint venture
classes.definition: legal entity that is formed between parties that pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task but otherwise retain their distinct identities

classes.name: non-governmental organization
classes.label: non-governmental organization
classes.definition: not-for-profit organization that functions independently of government

classes.name: not for profit organization
classes.label: not for profit organization
classes.definition: organization that uses its surplus revenues to further achieve its purpose rather than distributing its surplus income to the organization's owners (directors, investors, and equivalents) as profit / dividends

classes.name: organization covering agreement
classes.label: organization covering agreement
classes.definition: contract between the principals in a formal organization that specifies the relationship between the principals, and between the principals and the entity

classes.name: value-added tax identification number
classes.label: value-added tax identification number
classes.definition: tax identifier that identifies a taxable person (business) or non-taxable legal entity for a consumption tax that is assessed incrementally, levied on the price of a product or service at each stage of production, distribution, and sale to the end consumer

classes.name: business entity
classes.label: business entity
classes.definition: entity that is formed and administered as per commercial law in order to engage in business activities

classes.name: business license
classes.label: business license
classes.definition: license that allows the holder to conduct business or carry out a specific profession within some jurisdiction for some period of time

classes.name: chartered legal person
classes.label: chartered legal person
classes.definition: a legal person created by a royal charter or decree

classes.name: legally competent natural person
classes.label: legally competent natural person
classes.definition: person who is considered competent, under the circumstances, to enter into a contract, conduct business, or participate in other activities that generally require the mental ability to understand problems and make decisions on his or her own behalf

classes.name: not for profit objective
classes.label: not for profit objective
classes.definition: objective that reflects the charitable, educational, religious, humanitarian, public services, or other not for profit goals of an organization

classes.name: power of attorney
classes.label: power of attorney
classes.definition: legal authorization given by one party (the principal) to another (the agent or attorney-in-fact) to perform certain acts on the principal's behalf

classes.name: profit objective
classes.label: profit objective
classes.definition: objective that reflects pursuit of a financial benefit that may be realized when the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

classes.name: public purpose
classes.label: public purpose
classes.definition: objective that reflects values generally thought to be shared by and that is intended to benefit the populace as a whole

classes.name: religious objective
classes.label: religious objective
classes.definition: not-for-profit objective that reflects the religious goals of an organization

classes.name: fonds commun de placement
classes.label: fonds commun de placement
classes.definition: legal entity created to fulfill narrow, specific, and frequently temporary objectives

classes.name: statutory body
classes.label: statutory body
classes.definition: legal entity established by a government to consider evidence and make judgements in some field of activity

classes.name: variable interest entity
classes.label: variable interest entity
classes.definition: legal entity whose shareholders are entitled to a percentage of a named company's profits via a private contract

classes.name: accounting framework
classes.label: accounting framework
classes.definition: framework, including policies, methods, rules, and processes, used to measure, recognize, present, and disclose the information appearing in an entity's financial statements, and, from a legal ownership perspective, that is applied for accounting consolidation determination

classes.name: contractually capable entity
classes.label: contractually capable entity
classes.definition: a unique entity that is legally or financially responsible for the performance of financial transactions, or has the legal right in its jurisdiction to enter independently into legal contracts, regardless of whether it is incorporated or constituted in some other way (e.g. trust, partnership, contractual). This excludes natural persons, but includes governmental organizations and supranationals.

classes.name: entity legal form
classes.label: entity legal form
classes.definition: a classifier for a legal entity that indicates the nature of that entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective, in the jurisdiction in which it was established

classes.name: entity legal form identifier
classes.label: entity legal form identifier
classes.definition: code that denotes an entity legal form as defined in ISO 20275

classes.name: entity legal form scheme
classes.label: entity legal form scheme
classes.definition: scheme that specifies the elements of the codes for entity legal forms, such as those that are sanctioned in a given jurisdiction as defined in ISO 20725

classes.name: LEI registered entity
classes.label: LEI registered entity
classes.definition: a legal person that has registered for and is identified by a legal entity identifier

classes.name: legal entity identifier
classes.label: legal entity identifier
classes.definition: an organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal person as defined in ISO 17442

classes.name: legal entity identifier scheme
classes.label: legal entity identifier scheme
classes.definition: a scheme that specifies the elements of an unambiguous legal entity identifier (LEI) scheme to identify the legal entities relevant to any financial transaction

classes.name: relationship period qualifier
classes.label: relationship period qualifier
classes.definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the reporting period specified, such as that the date period reflects an accounting or document filing period

classes.name: relationship qualifier
classes.label: relationship qualifier
classes.definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period, such as the accounting framework used

classes.name: relationship record
classes.label: relationship record
classes.definition: a record describing relationships between legal entities

classes.name: relationship status
classes.label: relationship status
classes.definition: a classifier that specifies the status of the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period (active or inactive)

classes.name: contractual control
classes.label: contractual control

classes.name: controlled party
classes.label: controlled party
classes.definition: person or organization over which some party exercises some form of authority or influence with respect to some situation

classes.name: controlling alliance
classes.label: controlling alliance
classes.definition: group that has formed some alliance to jointly exercise control over some entity

classes.name: court appointed control
classes.label: court appointed control
classes.definition: control conferred by the actions of some court, for example in the context of receivership

classes.name: de facto controlling interest party
classes.label: de facto controlling interest party
classes.definition: party that exercises some control over an entity other than via explicit, legal means

classes.name: de jure controlling interest party
classes.label: de jure controlling interest party

classes.name: entity controlling party
classes.label: entity controlling party
classes.definition: party that has the authority to control some legal entity

classes.name: influence-based de facto control
classes.label: influence-based de facto control
classes.definition: informal control that involves influence over some party

classes.name: influence-based de facto controlling party
classes.label: influence-based de facto controlling party
classes.definition: party that holds influence-based control over some other party

classes.name: investment-based de facto control

rules.value: investment-based de facto controlling interest party

classes.name: investment-based de facto controlling interest party
classes.label: investment-based de facto controlling interest party
classes.definition: party that holds investment-based control over some other party

classes.name: joint controlling party
classes.label: joint controlling party
classes.definition: party that collectively has the authority to control the affairs of some business organization

classes.name: majority controlling party
classes.label: majority controlling party

classes.name: receiver
classes.label: receiver
classes.definition: party appointed by some court for the purposes of winding up the affairs of some entity which is no longer solvent

classes.name: sole controlling party
classes.label: sole controlling party
classes.definition: party that has sole control over and directs the affairs of some legal entity

classes.name: total owner
classes.label: total owner
classes.definition: party that has 100 percent ownership some legal entity

classes.name: affiliate
classes.label: affiliate
classes.definition: party that is related to a legal entity, directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, and controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with that entity, typically determined by the degree of ownership

classes.name: affiliation
classes.label: affiliation
classes.definition: situation in which a controlled party is affiliated with a controlling party for some period of time

classes.name: controlled affiliate
classes.label: controlled affiliate
classes.definition: controlled party in an affiliation situation

classes.name: controlling affiliate
classes.label: controlling affiliate
classes.definition: controlling party in an affiliation situation

classes.name: domestic ultimate parent
classes.label: domestic ultimate parent
classes.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization within the country or jurisdiction of incorporation or organization

classes.name: global ultimate parent
classes.label: global ultimate parent
classes.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization world-wide

classes.name: joint venture partner
classes.label: joint venture partner
classes.definition: party that shares capital, technology, human resources, risks, and benefits of an entity under shared control

classes.name: significant shareholder
classes.label: significant shareholder
classes.definition: party that owns a significant voting stake in an organization that is less than 50 percent but greater than some threshold

classes.name: subsidiary
classes.label: subsidiary
classes.definition: legal entity that is entirely or majority owned and controlled by another legal entity

classes.name: total controlling interest party
classes.label: total controlling interest party
classes.definition: voting shareholder that owns 100 percent of the voting shares in some legal entity

classes.name: voting shareholder
classes.label: voting shareholder
classes.definition: shareholder whose shares confer the right to vote in corporate elections, including the right to elect directors at annual or special meetings, and to express their views to corporate management and directors on significant issues that may affect the value of those shares

classes.name: beneficial owner
classes.label: beneficial owner
classes.definition: party that enjoys the benefits of ownership (such as receipt of income) of something even though its ownership (title) may be in the name of another party (called a nominee or registered owner)

classes.name: beneficial ownership
classes.label: beneficial ownership
classes.definition: situation linking party that enjoys the benefits of ownership (such as receipt of income) of something even though its ownership (title) may be in the name of another party (called a nominee or registered owner) to the asset that they own

classes.name: purchase lot
classes.label: purchase lot

classes.name: shareholder
classes.label: shareholder
classes.definition: party that owns shares in and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some asset, provided in exchange for investment

classes.name: shareholding
classes.label: shareholding
classes.definition: ownership interest in the equity of a company, represented by shares that confer financial rights and governance privileges

classes.name: tax lot
classes.label: tax lot
classes.definition: financial asset that is a block of securities or other financial assets with a distinct cost basis for tax reporting purposes

classes.name: articles of incorporation
classes.label: articles of incorporation

classes.name: auditor
classes.label: auditor
classes.definition: party qualified and authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

classes.name: authorized individual
classes.label: authorized individual
classes.definition: role of an individual that has been given the responsibility to act on behalf of another party under some set of guidelines

classes.name: board capacity
classes.label: board capacity
classes.definition: authority to act in a fiduciary capacity with respect to the organization, including but not limited to determining and executing corporate policy

classes.name: board composition control
classes.label: board composition control
classes.definition: situation in which a voting shareholder, entity owner, or some other party in the case of a not-for-profit organization, appoints and/or nominates someone to the board of directors of an organization for some period of time

classes.name: board member
classes.label: board member
classes.definition: party that has fiduciary responsibility with respect to the organization, including but not limited to determining and executing corporate policy

classes.name: board membership
classes.label: board membership
classes.definition: situation relating an individual member of the board of directors to the organization

classes.name: board of directors
classes.label: board of directors
classes.definition: group of people comprising the governing body of an organization that has the authority to set organizational strategy and policies as well as to select and, to some degree manage, leadership

classes.name: bylaws
classes.label: bylaws
classes.definition: written rules for conduct of a corporation, association, partnership or any organization

classes.name: chief executive officer
classes.label: chief executive officer
classes.definition: top corporate officer responsible for an organization's overall operations and performance

classes.name: chief financial officer
classes.label: chief financial officer
classes.definition: senior-most corporate officer responsible for financial control and planning for an organization or project

classes.name: company law
classes.label: company law
classes.definition: legislation under which the formation, registration or incorporation, governance, and dissolution of a firm is administered and controlled

classes.name: company secretary
classes.label: company secretary
classes.definition: corporate officer appointed by the directors of an organization, responsible for ensuring compliance with legal obligations related to corporate governance

classes.name: controlling nominee
classes.label: controlling nominee
classes.definition: party that holds legal title to an asset (e.g., stocks, bonds, or property) on behalf of the beneficial owner

classes.name: corporate bylaws
classes.label: corporate bylaws
classes.definition: written rules for conduct of a corporation, adopted by the board of directors

classes.name: corporate officer
classes.label: corporate officer
classes.definition: high-level management executive of a corporation or other organization, hired by the board of directors or the business owner(s), charged with certain operational responsibilities, and who has the authority to act on behalf of the organization, including the authority to enter into contracts on behalf of the organization

classes.name: executive
classes.label: executive
classes.definition: person appointed and given the responsibility to manage the affairs of an organization and the authority to make decisions within specified role-specific boundaries

classes.name: executive board member
classes.label: executive board member
classes.definition: member of a board of directors that is also an employee of the organization

classes.name: external auditor
classes.label: external auditor
classes.definition: independent party qualified and authorized to examine and report on the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

classes.name: internal auditor
classes.label: internal auditor
classes.definition: employee who is qualified and authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records and evaluate internal controls and compliance

classes.name: non-executive board member
classes.label: non-executive board member
classes.definition: member of the board of directors of an organization that has no executive responsibilities towards the running of that organization

classes.name: principal party
classes.label: principal party
classes.definition: controlling party that is responsible for the management of daily business operations of an organization

classes.name: signatory
classes.label: signatory
classes.definition: responsible party authorized to sign agreements on behalf of themselves, another person, or an organization

classes.name: constitutional owner
classes.label: constitutional owner
classes.definition: entity owner that holds an equity stake in said entity, in the form of shareholders' equity

classes.name: controlling equity
classes.label: controlling equity
classes.definition: shareholders's equity that formally confers control in the entity, either by law or as explicitly stated in a corresponding equity instrument

classes.name: direct consolidation
classes.label: direct consolidation
classes.definition: direct ownership of an entity recorded as accounting consolidation

classes.name: entity owner
classes.label: entity owner
classes.definition: owner (person, group of people, or other business entity) that owns, or holds an ownership interest in, a formal business organization

classes.name: entity ownership
classes.label: entity ownership
classes.definition: ownership by some party of an interest in some non-governmental formal organization

classes.name: foreign branch ownership
classes.label: foreign branch ownership
classes.definition: ownership by some party of some formal organization or organizational sub-unit that is a foreign affiliate and legally part of the owning entity

classes.name: investment equity
classes.label: investment equity
classes.definition: equity that represents an ownership interest in some entity, but may or may not take the form of shareholders's equity

classes.name: investor
classes.label: investor
classes.definition: party that owns some stake in some organization by way of investment

classes.name: investor contract
classes.label: investor contract
classes.definition: Contract setting out the terms under which some investor invests in the entity and setting out the rights which are conferred on that investor.

classes.name: ultimate ownership
classes.label: ultimate ownership
classes.definition: highest-level (top, end) ancestral ownership, evidenced by accounting consolidation, by some party of some other legal entity

classes.name: general partner
classes.label: general partner

classes.name: general partnership
classes.label: general partnership
classes.definition: partnership that has at least two general partners that agree to share in all assets, profits, and financial and legal liabilities of the business

classes.name: limited liability limited partnership
classes.label: limited liability limited partnership
classes.definition: limited partnership that consists of one or more general partners who are liable for the obligations of the entity as well as one or more protected limited liability partners

classes.name: limited liability partnership
classes.label: limited liability partnership
classes.definition: partnership that has general partners but provides its individual partners some level of protection against personal liability for certain partnership liabilities

classes.name: limited partner
classes.label: limited partner
classes.definition: partner whose liabilities are limited to the extent of their investment or guarantees and that has no involvement in the day to day operations of the partnership

classes.name: limited partnership
classes.label: limited partnership
classes.definition: partnership that has at least one general partner and at least one limited partner

classes.name: partner
classes.label: partner
classes.definition: co-owner, member, and agent of a partnership whose participation level, including proportional liabilities and share in the profit / loss of the business is specified in a partnership agreement

classes.name: partnership
classes.label: partnership
classes.definition: association of two or more legal persons to carry on as co-owners a business for profit

classes.name: partnership agreement
classes.label: partnership agreement
classes.definition: contract between partners in a partnership that establishes the terms and conditions of the relationship between the partners

classes.name: limited liability company
classes.label: limited liability company
classes.definition: private limited company that combines the pass through taxation of a sole proprietorship or partnership with the limited liability of a corporation

classes.name: limited liability company member
classes.label: limited liability company member
classes.definition: owner of an interest in a limited liability company

classes.name: limited liability company taxed as a corporation
classes.label: limited liability company taxed as a corporation
classes.definition: limited liability company that has elected to have corporate tax status

classes.name: manager-managed limited liability company

classes.name: managing member
classes.label: managing member
classes.definition: owner of an interest in a limited liability company who also runs the day-to-day business operations

classes.name: private company with limited liability
classes.label: private company with limited liability
classes.definition: hybrid business entity having characteristics of both a corporation and a partnership or sole proprietorship (depending on how many owners there are)

classes.name: private limited company
classes.label: private limited company
classes.definition: private limited company whose shareholders' liability is limited to the capital they originally invested

classes.name: sole proprietor
classes.label: sole proprietor
classes.definition: party that owns a business, has the rights to all profits from that business and is considered a single entity (unincorporated) together with that business for tax and liability purposes

classes.name: sole proprietorship
classes.label: sole proprietorship
classes.definition: unincorporated business owned by a single person

classes.name: irrevocable trust
classes.label: irrevocable trust
classes.definition: trust that cannot be modified, amended or terminated except under certain legal circumstances and typically not without the permission of the grantor's named beneficiary or beneficiaries

classes.name: living trust
classes.label: living trust
classes.definition: trust created during an individual's lifetime where a designated person, the trustee, is given responsibility for managing that individual's assets for the benefit of the eventual beneficiary

classes.name: revocable trust
classes.label: revocable trust
classes.definition: trust in which legal ownership of the trust property is transferred to the trustee, but the trustor retains full power to revoke, modify or amend the trust

classes.name: testamentary trust
classes.label: testamentary trust
classes.definition: trust established in accordance with the instructions contained in a last will and testament

classes.name: trust
classes.label: trust
classes.definition: fiduciary relationship and legal entity in which one party, known as a trustor, gives another party, the trustee, the right to hold title to and manage assets for the benefit of a third party, the beneficiary

classes.name: trust agreement
classes.label: trust agreement
classes.definition: formal agreement that establishes a trust, whereby the trustor(s) gives the trustee(s) the responsibility to hold and manage assets for the beneficiary(ies)

classes.name: trust beneficiary
classes.label: trust beneficiary
classes.definition: party for whose interest (benefit) an annuity, assignment (such as a letter of credit), contract, insurance policy, judgment, promise, trust, will, etc., is made

classes.name: trust fund manager
classes.label: trust fund manager
classes.definition: party empowered to act on behalf of the trustee to manage the assets of the trust

classes.name: trustee
classes.label: trustee
classes.definition: party that holds and manages assets for the benefit of another

classes.name: trustor
classes.label: trustor
classes.definition: party that establishes a trust and places property under the protection and management of one or more trustees for the benefit of at least one beneficiary
